sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Jaykob P. Thacker.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Before joining the American Fork Police Department, Thacker worked as a police officer for the Lone Peak Public Safety District. Officer Thacker worked for the American Fork Police Department from November 20, 2019, to August 14, 2025. In 2025, he joined the Utah County Sheriff’s Office as a Deputy Sheriff II – Enforcement.
